keep.text: Aap ek drug addict ho
aur aapko pata bhi nahi hai. Aur drug ka naam pata hai kya hai?
Sugar.
Agar koi bole aapko ki cocaine ki aadat hai,
toh aap kahoge ki rehab jao bhai, ilaaj karao, cocaine chhod do, nasha chhod do. But koi bole aapko ki sweet tooth hai, mujhe meetha bahut pasand hai, toh aap hans doge us par.
Par science kehti hai ki sugar aapke brain ke usi center ko hit karta hai jisko cocaine hit karta hai,
aur 8 guna zyada addictive hai sugar cocaine se.
Samjho ye kaam kaise karta hai. Aapke brain mein area hota hai nucleus accumbens, aur ye aapka reward center hai.
Jab aap meetha khaate ho na
toh aapka dopamine release hota hai, aur dopamine ek pleasure hormone hai, aapko achha lagne lagta hai.
Jab jab aap meetha khaoge tab tab aapko achha lagega. Par problem ye nahi hai.
Problem ye hai ki jitna zyada aap log sugar khaate ho
aapka center
usi sugar pe aur depend ho jaata hai.
Matlab pehle ek laddoo kha ke khushi milti thi,
ab
do laddoo kha ke khushi milegi,
phir teen laddoo kha ke khushi milegi, phir chaar,
paanch,
aise karke badhta chala jaayega. Aur ye exactly wahi pattern hai jo cocaine addiction mein hota hai.
Aur isi tareeke se cocaine ki bhi
tolerance build hoti chali jaati hai, aur isi tareeke se sugar ki bhi tolerance build hoti chali jaati hai.
Ab sochiye, 73% Indian protein deficient hain.
Protein nahi milta hai body ko toh sugar ki craving manufacture karti hai, aur namak toh aap waise bhi kam kha rahe ho,
toh wahan se sugar craving aur badh jaati hai. Matlab India mein dono taraf se sugar push ho rahi hai, aur isi liye diabetes capital ho gaya India.
Is aadat ko todne ke liye ek system chahiye. Jaise cocaine ki aadat ko todne ke liye ek system lagta hai, ek rehab lagta hai, waise hi meethe ko todne ke liye ek rehab lagta hai,
ek system lagta hai.
Aur sirf meetha mat khao bolne se kuch bhi nahi hoga.
Brain ko rewire karna padega, protein timing fix karni padegi, sodium balance karna padega, aur tab jaake isko ek integrated approach
kaha jaayega, integrated system kaha jaayega.
Aur maine ye system poora ka poora build kiya ekdam achhe tareeke se. Jab mujhe samajh mein aaya na
toh mujhe ye cheez pata chal gayi
ki kaise weight ghatega. Aur main sabse fastest weight ghataya hoon abhi tak mere jaanne mein.
Aur ye saari cheez sirf aur sirf system ki wajah se hui hai.
Agar aap logon ko bhi ye system chahiye
toh comment box mein likho SYSTEM.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer. Milte hain next video mein!
